CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #13
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Hiding stolen items
   B. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   C. Cheating in exams
   D. Spreading rumours

2. Which response best shows understanding of The call of Moses? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of The call of Moses with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The call of Moses.
   C. Use The call of Moses to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say The call of Moses has no place in daily life.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Bible Stories: Peter and John in the Temple? (1 mark)
   A. Say Bible Stories: Peter and John in the Temple has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Bible Stories: Peter and John in the Temple to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Bible Stories: Peter and John in the Temple with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Bible Stories: Peter and John in the Temple.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Work? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Work with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Work has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Work.
   D. Use Work to insult classmates of other faiths.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Family Unity? (1 mark)
   A. Use Family Unity to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Family Unity has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Family Unity with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Family Unity.

6. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Waste food daily
   B. Destroy trees without planting
   C. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   D. Pollute rivers deliberately

7. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   B. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   C. Skipping all moral lessons
   D. Refusing to help a neighbour

8. Which response best shows understanding of The Fall of Man? (1 mark)
   A. Use The Fall of Man to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Fall of Man.
   C. Apply the teaching of The Fall of Man with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say The Fall of Man has no place in daily life.

9. Which response best shows understanding of King Solomon the wise ruler? (1 mark)
   A. Say King Solomon the wise ruler has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of King Solomon the wise ruler with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use King Solomon the wise ruler to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing King Solomon the wise ruler.

10. Which response best shows understanding of Mount Carmel Contest? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Mount Carmel Contest with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Mount Carmel Contest has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Mount Carmel Contest.
   D. Use Mount Carmel Contest to insult classmates of other faiths.

11. Which response best shows understanding of Noah and his sons? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Noah and his sons with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Noah and his sons.
   C. Say Noah and his sons has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Noah and his sons to insult classmates of other faiths.

12. Which response best shows understanding of A hand writes on the wall? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing A hand writes on the wall.
   B. Say A hand writes on the wall has no place in daily life.
   C. Use A hand writes on the wall to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of A hand writes on the wall with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Noah and his sons and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain A hand writes on the wall and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Mount Carmel Contest and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain The Birth of Moses and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
